body: 掃描發現 Kissei 橘生製藥（TSE: 4547）的 rovatirelin（KPS-0373）在日本藥證 2023/07 撤回後重啟的第三次 Ph3 確認試驗已登錄（NCT07040137）：多中心隨機雙盲安慰劑對照、口服每日一次 24 週、n=142、主要指標＝SARA 總分自基線變化，2025/07 起於日本收案，主要完成估 2027/03。
note: → 與本社日本承認申請面對同一監管機關（PMDA）、同一主要量表（SARA）、重疊的 SCD 市場範疇。PMDA 當年以「以現有臨床資料難以核准」要求 Kissei 補做第三個 Ph3，是日本對 SCD 療效證據門檻最直接的公開案例；其 2027/03 的讀出時點值得納入本社日本策略時程一併考量。

en.body: The sweep found that Kissei Pharmaceutical (TSE: 4547) has registered the third Ph3 confirmatory study of rovatirelin (KPS-0373) that it restarted after withdrawing its Japanese application in 2023/07 (NCT07040137): multicentre, randomised, double-blind and placebo-controlled, dosed orally once daily for 24 weeks, n=142, with change from baseline in total SARA as the primary endpoint; recruiting in Japan since 2025/07, primary completion estimated 2027/03.
en.note: → It faces the same regulator (PMDA), the same primary scale (SARA) and an overlapping SCD market scope as Steminent's Japanese application. The PMDA's position that approval would be difficult on the existing clinical data — and the resulting demand for a third Ph3 — is the most direct public case study of Japan's evidence bar in SCD, and the 2027/03 readout is worth folding into Steminent's Japanese strategic timeline.

body: 主動掃描發現清單外玩家 Solid Biosciences（NASDAQ: SLDB）：其 Friedreich's Ataxia 基因療法 SGT-212 首次人體 Ph1b（NCT07180355）自 2025/10 起收案，n≈10、追蹤約 5 年，站點為 UCLA、俄亥俄州立大學與費城兒童醫院。
note: → 關鍵在遞送策略：雙側小腦齒狀核直接注輸＋靜脈輸注雙途徑，正對應 Biogen BIIB132（ATXN3 ASO）當年「標的對、載具送不到深部小腦」的失敗主因。目前僅 FA 適應症、未見延伸 SCA，但若安全性成立，將成為 polyQ／SCA 基因療法遞送路線的重要參照。

en.body: The proactive sweep picked up an off-list player, Solid Biosciences (NASDAQ: SLDB): its Friedreich's ataxia gene therapy SGT-212 has been recruiting into a first-in-human Ph1b (NCT07180355) since 2025/10, with n≈10 and roughly 5 years of follow-up, at UCLA, Ohio State University and Children's Hospital of Philadelphia.
en.note: → The delivery strategy is the point: bilateral direct infusion into the cerebellar dentate nucleus combined with an IV dose, aimed squarely at the failure mode of Biogen's BIIB132 (ATXN3 ASO) — right target, but the vehicle could not reach the deep cerebellum. It is in FA only for now with no announced SCA extension, but if the safety profile holds it becomes a key reference for gene-therapy delivery in polyQ and SCA.

body: 新發現競品：IntraBio levacetylleucine（N-acetyl-L-leucine）之 CACNA1A 相關疾病 Ph3 樞紐試驗 IB1001-304（NCT07221292）已於 2026/05 獲美/英/歐盟/瑞士監管放行，12 個跨國站點啟動中，估 2026/09 開始收案、n≈60，主要指標為 SARA。
note: → 適應症明列 SCA6，與本社日本承認申請（SCA3/6）之 SCA6 部分正面重疊；惟其為口服症狀改善型小分子（同成分 Aqneursa 已於 NPC 上市），與細胞治療的疾病修飾定位不同。

en.body: Newly identified competitor: IntraBio's levacetylleucine (N-acetyl-L-leucine) pivotal Ph3 trial in CACNA1A-related disorders, IB1001-304 (NCT07221292), received regulatory authorisation to proceed in the US, UK, EU and Switzerland in 2026/05; 12 multinational sites are activating, enrolment estimated to start 2026/09 with n≈60 and SARA as the primary endpoint.
en.note: → The listed indications explicitly include SCA6, overlapping the SCA6 half of our Japanese marketing application (SCA3/6). It is, however, an oral symptomatic small molecule (the same molecule is already marketed as Aqneursa in NPC), positioned differently from disease-modifying cell therapy.

body: 本社 Stemchymal：6/24 產品「承認申請」(SCA3/6) 送 PMDA；6/18 MAH「業許可」送神奈川縣。

en.body: Our Stemchymal: marketing approval application (SCA3/6) filed with PMDA on 6/24; MAH business licence filed with Kanagawa Prefecture on 6/18.

body: 美國二期試驗細節公布：UCLA＋USF 兩站點、預計 2026/09 首例收案，收案 20 人（SCA3），共同主持人 Susan Perlman、Theresa Zesiewicz 醫師；採真實世界數據並事先與 FDA 協議統計分析計畫（SAP）——為 Troriluzole 教訓後的設計調整。

en.body: Details of the US Phase 2 released: two sites, UCLA and USF, with first patient expected 2026/09, enrolling 20 patients (SCA3), co-led by Drs Susan Perlman and Theresa Zesiewicz; it uses real-world data with a statistical analysis plan (SAP) agreed with FDA in advance — a design change learned from the troriluzole experience.

body: Vico 的 ASO VO659（SCA1/SCA3/HD）2026/02/24 進入半年一次給藥 Ph1/2。
note: → 與本社在 SCA3 重疊，但 SCA 尚無明確療效（SCA3 生物標記混合/微弱、SCA1 無；明確正面在 HD）；曾見 radiculitis（神經根發炎，多數恢復中）。仍 Ph1/2a、遠期。

en.body: Vico’s ASO VO659 (SCA1/SCA3/HD) moved to a twice-yearly dosing Ph1/2 on 2026/02/24.
en.note: → Overlaps with us in SCA3, but there is still no clear efficacy in SCA (SCA3 biomarkers mixed/weak, none in SCA1; the clear positive is in HD); radiculitis (nerve-root inflammation, mostly resolving) has been observed. Still Ph1/2a and years away.
